events.title: Demo v1.0.5 Update
events.summary: ■Demo v1.0.5 Update- Added one-time tips that appear in key moments for new players.- Your team is now always shown on the left on the team intro, round results and final results screens, with a "YOU" marker on your character.- The team intro screen now shows each team's goal.- Reduced text in the middle of the screen so the crowd is easier to see. ("You stand out" is now shown by the flashing RISK meter, and "Informant approaching" moved to the top-right feed.)- Added sound effects for ONI inve

events.title: Demo v1.0.4 Update
events.summary: ■Demo v1.0.4 Update・Adjusted the default volume balance for new players.・Added sound effects to the struggle when being escorted.・The intro screen now shows "Back Start" next to the time limit when Back Start is on.

events.title: Demo v1.0.3 Update
events.summary: ■Demo v1.0.3 Update - Added "Back Start" to stage select. VECTORs start from the back of the stage, and every ONI begins with all wanted posters. - Added "Members" to the room menu. See who is in the room and your round-trip time to the host. - Adjusted BGM volume balance. - Fixed characters sometimes spawning in unreachable places such as rooftops. - Improved menu cursor behavior with mouse and controller.

events.title: Demo v1.0.2 Update
events.summary: ■Demo v1.0.2 Update Adjusted how each round is set up when it starts. On the final results screen, pressing NEXT now lets you choose KEEP PLAYING or WAITING ROOM.

events.title: DEMO version 1.0.1 update
events.summary: ■ Demo Version 1.0.1 UpdateAdded a "DISPLAY" menu to the settings.You can now toggle full-screen mode and change the window resolution.

events.title: TOKYO WANTED free demo is out now
events.summary: The TOKYO WANTED demo is out today. It's available for a limited time, until the full game launches — so you can play it throughout Steam Next Fest (Oct 19–26 PT). What's in the demoUp to six players online (3v3). CPU players fill empty seats, so you can play solo Passphrase rooms for playing with friends or your viewers 13 languages Streaming and videosStreaming, videos and monetisation are all welcome — the demo included.
